description: A React Native component for displaying detailed patterns and message analysis related to a session, including fetching data from backend APIs, rendering pattern cards with status, confidence, evidence, and message context.

methods.name: loadPatternDetails
methods.description: Fetches session data and messages, filters patterns for the specified speaker, and updates state.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns color code based on pattern status.

methods.name: getStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns icon name based on pattern status.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats timestamp into a human-readable time string.
